text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun,
do you mind if we stop by that café we visited before?
choice_data_list: We have plenty of time, so sure.
We have plenty of time, so sure.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... While I have the chance,
there's something I want to tell the shopkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Shopkeeper, I've come today not as a customer,
but to speak with you directly.

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text: Talk...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When I came here previously,
I was unable to convince the master.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't shake that frustration from back then...
I really wanted to talk to you one more time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Along with this—presentation material!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —First, let's look at the current data.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The clientele consists mainly of adults rather than youths, with many solo customers,
averaging about one to two people per visit."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The main purpose is reading, studying, or work. Many adults looking to make good use of their time alone tend to use it—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In other words, what this shop needs to make its weapon is a space where one can relax all on their own...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Dimming the lights, unifying the interior with wood, placing antique decor around, and so forth—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "If we give it a 'hidden hideaway' vibe and use that as an initial hook to attract adult customers, we should definitely have a solid chance of winning!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How is it, Shopkeeper...!

Biwa Hayahide's drive and passion were so intense,
it felt as though she had just run an entire race.

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised. To think someone
could be so passionate about my shop.

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
However,
why are you trying so hard to convince me...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
One reason is simply that I am a regular,
and I'm very fond of this shop.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And the other reason is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because I believe.
That theory can reach the heights of natural talent.

The light of conviction fills Biwa Hayahide's eyes.
...Her words are the very embodiment of how she lives her life.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When I first heard about Master,
to be honest, it didn't feel like someone else's problem.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Because in reality, I myself have experienced being overwhelmed by the sheer presence of the strong.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter how overwhelming of a presence appears,
there must always be a way to fight back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I believe in it. That is why
I wanted Master to understand as well."

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, young lady...
I'll take some time to rethink my future.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness.
I was able to talk to them before the shop closed down.
choice_data_list: That was convincing precisely because it came from you.
It was convincing precisely because it came from you.
Your theory really resonates with me.
Your theory really resonates with me.
Seeing that gave me courage too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness.
I was able to talk to them before the shop closed down.
choice_data_list: That was convincing precisely because it came from you.
It was convincing precisely because it came from you.
Your theory really resonates with me.
Your theory really resonates with me.
Seeing that gave me courage too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So precisely because I am one
who has systematically built up theory, you say?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, coming from someone still going through trial and error,
I suppose it sounds a bit presumptuous of me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet precisely because I know the hardship,
I didn't want the owner to give up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I truly hope from the bottom of my heart
that these feelings reach the shopkeeper as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, was I being a bit too overbearing?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: When it comes to things I find worthwhile or truly love, I have a tendency to go completely all-in.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't intended to prepare presentation materials,
but I ended up making them anyway.
choice_data_list: It's amazing you can just make that on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, thanks to the materials,
I think I was able to convey everything to the fullest."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ho... Is that how it works?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If theory can grant courage,
then I'd be more than glad.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have a fair bit of confidence in my analytical ability.
Just say the word whenever you need it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I shall approach it from various angles
and analyze it thoroughly.
And so, a few days later—
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, whatever happened to that café?
Come to think of it, whatever happened to that café?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it continues even now.
—Look.

Peering into the cafe from outside,
you can see customers relaxing in a cozy, hidden-getaway atmosphere.

Drinking coffee, enjoying a good book...
A cozy, welcoming atmosphere drifted through the air.
choice_data_list: The owner and Hayahide's hard work really bore fruit...
The owner and Hayahide's hard work really bore fruit...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Thank goodness... truly.

Biwa Hayahide looked truly happy,
and watching her warmed my heart as well.
